en: A black-and-white postcard image showing a grand historical theater building to the left and a row of ornate, multi-story buildings along a curved street. In front, there are trimmed trees, pedestrians, carriages, and what appears to be an old tram or bus. The background consists of a wooded hill. The text at the top identifies the location as 'Karlsbad. Theater, Neue und Alte Wiese.'
